listing.name: Quake III Arena (ioquake3)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official ioquake3 Windows/macOS/Linux build from ioquake3.org/get-it; own Quake III Arena / Team Arena PK3 data. Limits: Mature native engine for original Quake III and Team Arena. Original game data remains proprietary; no GitHub Releases returned, confirm current packaging. Upstream platforms: Official Windows/Linux/macOS builds at ioquake3.org; Linux x86-64 explicitly supported. macOS Universal2 Intel x86-64/Apple-Silicon ARM64 and legacy Universal1 builds are separately documented. Original data: Original game data remains proprietary; no GitHub Releases returned, confirm current packaging. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
